$comment: Production record, 29 Aug 2026, UNMODIFIED. omsstats was the one type pre-29-August payload schema already got right; this pins that. NOTE: production sends tenant == maintenant == "mzc", which is exactly the trap: only tenant isolates, and equal values cannot reveal a filter on the wrong field. This fixture is kept byte-faithful because its job is to be a production regression guard; it is NOT an isolation test. The *-tenant-isolation-pair.json fixtures, where the two values deliberately differ, remain the only isolation guards.
